name: johnnickell/fight-common
description: A shared PHP library for Hexagonal Architecture, CQRS, and reusable domain primitives

suggest.codeigniter4/framework: Required by the CodeIgniter transaction and capability service delegates
suggest.codeigniter4/queue: Required by the CodeIgniter Queue messaging adapters
suggest.deptrac/deptrac: Required to run optional architecture checks in a consuming repository
suggest.dragonmantank/cron-expression: Required by the Scheduler for cron expression parsing
suggest.doctrine/dbal: Required by the custom doctrine data types
suggest.doctrine/orm: Required by the canonical Doctrine transactional unit of work, legacy 1.x unit of work, audit repository, and base repository
suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: Required by the guzzle http client adapter
suggest.guzzlehttp/promises: Required by the guzzle http client adapter
suggest.guzzlehttp/psr7: Required by the guzzle http client adapter
suggest.lcobucci/jwt: Required by the jwt token encoder and decoder
suggest.laravel/framework: Required by the Laravel queue, transaction, and capability provider adapters
suggest.league/flysystem: Required by the flysystem file storage adapter
suggest.symfony/dependency-injection: Required by the Symfony compilation passes
suggest.symfony/event-dispatcher: Required by the validation and other event subscribers
suggest.symfony/http-foundation: Required for the JSend response and other HTTP related utilities
suggest.symfony/http-kernel: Required for the kernel middleware and other HTTP related utilities
suggest.symfony/mailer: Required by the Symfony mail transport and attachment adapters
suggest.symfony/mercure: Required by the public and private Mercure hub publishers
suggest.symfony/messenger: Required by the async messenger command bus and event dispatcher
suggest.symfony/process: Required by the Symfony process runner adapter
suggest.slevomat/coding-standard: Required by the optional FightCommon PHP_CodeSniffer standard
suggest.squizlabs/php_codesniffer: Required to run the optional FightCommon PHP_CodeSniffer standard
suggest.phpseclib/phpseclib: Required by the SFTP file transport adapter
suggest.psr/simple-cache: Required by the optional PSR-16 read-through cache adapter
suggest.twilio/sdk: Required by the Twilio SMS transport adapter
suggest.twig/twig: Required by the Twig template engine adapter
